symptom: PC commands were sometimes fragmented and produced Unknown command or Python timeout
root_cause: PC serial input was treated as complete commands although input could arrive fragmented
fix: Added robust command reconstruction and protected DUT UART access with a FreeRTOS mutex

symptom: Simultaneous OPEN and CLOSED end-stops did not reliably trigger SAFE
root_cause: POSITION_CONTRADICTORY was generated by endstops.c but was lost when converted to limit_open and limit_closed booleans
fix: Added explicit position_contradictory field to sensor snapshot and EVENT_CONTRADICTION handling
